release_notes: Orbitra 2.0.2: long sustained traffic peaks no longer pause click processing to compact the database log — under load the write-ahead log is allowed to grow and folds back when traffic subsides (a forced fold exists for disk-space safety alone: log over 50% of free space or under 2 GB free), and web requests never truncate it. Stand-proven: 480 rps for 15 minutes — 0 errors out of 432k clicks, p99 146 ms, a 17.5 GB log folded right after the load without a pause. System status now shows the log size against free disk space, warns past 10% of free space, and marks a big log waiting for a quiet moment to compact. Also: a stream filter whose payload reached the database as a string (API, imports, hand-edited rows) no longer turns every click on the campaign into HTTP 500 (2.0.0 field report).
